about_pullquote: We don't charge for call-outs and we never oversell work you don't need.
about_para_1: City Electrical Services started in Birmingham back in 2006 when Paul decided there had to be a better way to find a trustworthy, fairly priced electrician. Eighteen years on, we've rewired homes, installed systems in new builds, and fixed countless emergencies across the city. Every electrician on our books is NICEIC registered and trained to current Building Regulations.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, being honest about what needs doing, and not charging extra because you're in a jam. Customers come back because we listen, explain the work clearly, and finish the job right. We're as comfortable working in a terraced house in Moseley as we are in a commercial unit in Digbeth.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Called them at 9pm with a total power loss. Paul arrived by 10:15 and found a faulty switch that was about to cause serious damage. Fixed it and made sure everything else was safe. Charged a fair price without trying to upsell me. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had them rewire my whole house. They were professional, tidy, and didn't mess about. Explained everything as they went and answered all my questions. Certificate came through straight away. Would definitely recommend them to anyone.
reviews.author: Margaret W.

reviews.text: Needed an EICR done before selling. They came within 2 days, found a couple of issues, and sent a clear report. No pressure to fix everything immediately, just honest advice. That's rare. Top marks.
reviews.author: James C.
